general.textSizeDesc: Adjust the editor's base font size.
general.keepRunningDesc: Closing the window keeps Pear Notes running in the tray so your notes stay in sync.
general.startAtLoginDesc: Launch Pear Notes automatically when you sign in to this device.
general.meteredConnectionDesc: Also holds media transfers. Desktop cannot detect metered networks automatically, so set this yourself.
general.keepRunningUnlinked: Link another device to keep Pear Notes syncing in the background.

privacy.screenDesc: Protect your locked notes with biometrics or a custom password, and guard against screenshots and app-switcher previews.
privacy.noteLockDesc: Lock individual notes from the note menu. Unlocks with {{method}}.
privacy.noteLockPasswordDesc: Locked notes unlock with your custom password on all synced devices.
privacy.noteLockUnavailableDesc: Device lock isn't set up on this device. Change the lock method from another synced device.
privacy.changeMethodReason: Authenticate to change the note lock method
privacy.blockScreenshotsDesc: Prevent screenshots while viewing a locked note.
privacy.hideInSwitcherDesc: Cover note content in the app switcher while viewing a locked note.
privacy.unlockMethodDesc: Choose how locked notes are unlocked.

reset.confirmMessage: This will permanently delete all your notes, media, and files on this device. This action cannot be undone and your data cannot be recovered if you haven't backed it up or synced with another device.

mediaSync.title: Media sync
mediaSync.pauseMediaDesc: Hold photos, video, and file transfers. Notes, folders, and settings keep syncing.
mediaSync.heldNotice: Media transfers are held. Queued items resume automatically once media is allowed again.
mediaSync.holdOnCellularDesc: Automatically hold photos, video, and files while on a mobile connection.

descriptions.general: Customize your personal workspace experience, from aesthetics to native language supports.
descriptions.sync: Manage your secure peer-to-peer network and linked devices with end-to-end encryption.
descriptions.backup: Create encrypted backups of your notes and media, or restore from a previous backup file.
descriptions.storage: Monitor your notes data size, on-disk footprint, and reclaim storage by clearing unreachable media.
descriptions.activity: See what each linked device has created, changed and removed.

verdict.noDevices: Link a device to start syncing. Background and media settings apply once a device is linked.
verdict.neverSynced: Waiting for {{device}}. Both devices need to be online and on a network at the same time.
verdict.waiting: Waiting for {{device}} to come online. Notes will sync as soon as both devices are reachable.
verdict.canSleep: Running in the background. This computer can still sleep, which pauses syncing — disable sleep in your power settings to keep other devices up to date.

sync.title: Link Devices

hero.title: Link Your Devices
hero.description: Create a secure, end-to-end encrypted connection to sync your notes across devices instantly.

invite.qrDescription: Open the link screen on your other device and scan this QR code to paste the invite instantly.
invite.warning: For security, don't share this code in public channels as it grants full access to your notes.
invite.expiredDesc: For security, invites are valid for {{minutes}} minutes. Generate a new one to link a device.

sync.footer: Your data moves directly between devices using encrypted Hypercore logs. No central server involved.

permissions.cameraDescription: Allow camera access to scan an invite QR code and fill the pairing code automatically.

scanner.title: Scan invite QR code
scanner.description: Point your camera at the QR code shown on your other device to fill the invite automatically.

delete.title: Remove Device?
delete.description: The device will lose the data sync and all data will be removed from that device.

backgroundSync.offDesc: Sync only while the app is open.
backgroundSync.periodicDesc: The OS occasionally wakes Pear Notes in the background to sync — low battery impact.
backgroundSync.alwaysOnDesc: Keep syncing continuously in the background with a persistent notification.
backgroundSync.permissionDescription: Allow notifications so Pear Notes can show a persistent sync status while running in the background.

folders.title: Folders
folders.deleteDescription: This folder and its notes will be deleted.

empty.noNotesSubtitle: Tap the compose button to create one
empty.trashEmptySubtitle: Notes you delete appear here for {{days}} days before they are removed for good.
empty.onboardingSubtitle: Write something new, connect another device to sync, or restore from a backup file.
empty.noNotesHint: Tap + to create a note in this folder

folderView.trashRetentionNotice: Notes here are permanently removed after {{days}} days.

noteCard.deleteConfirmation: Are you sure you want to delete this note?
noteCard.authUnavailableDesc: This device has no biometrics or passcode set up, so notes can't be locked or unlocked here. Set up device security, or change the lock method from another synced device.
noteCard.lockedNoAuthDesc: This note is locked and can't be opened on this device. Set up Face ID, Touch ID, or a device passcode in Settings to view it.
noteCard.lockedUnlockDesc: This note is protected. Use biometric to authenticate and view it.
noteCard.lockedUnlockFaceDesc: This note is protected. Use Face ID to view it.
noteCard.lockedUnlockFingerprintDesc: This note is protected. Use your fingerprint to view it.
noteCard.lockedUnlockPasswordDesc: This note is protected. Enter your note lock password to view it.

status.capturedSubtitle: Listen back, then save it into your note.
status.idleSubtitle: Tap the red button below to start or stop recording.

actions.stopHint: Tap to stop and review your voice note.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.message: The app hit an unexpected error. Reloading will recover your notes without data loss.
errorBoundary.description: The app hit an unexpected error. Reloading will recover your notes without data loss.

emptyState.title: Nothing open
emptyState.description: Pick a note from the list, or start a new one with the compose button.

lock.passwordProtected: This note is protected. Enter your note lock password to view it.
lock.authProtected: This note is protected. Use Touch ID or your login password to authenticate and view it.
lock.unavailable: This note is locked and can't be opened on this device. Set up device authentication (Touch ID or a login password) in System Settings to view it.

overlay.deviceRemovedDesc: This device has been removed from the synced cluster. Press Okay to clear local synced data and reset common storage.
overlay.resettingDesc: Removing synced data from this device...
overlay.linkedInviter: Your new device has been verified and linked successfully.
overlay.linkedReceiver: Welcome! This device is now a secure part of your notes library.
overlay.syncingDesc: Moving your notes and media to this device...
overlay.linkDesc: Enter the invite code from your other device to sync your notes securely.
overlay.mergeDesc: Notes, folders, and media on this device will be merged into the linked vault. Nothing on this device will be deleted.
overlay.verifyDesc: Ensure both devices display the same identification code.
overlay.identityDesc: Verifying connection. Please authorize on your other device.
overlay.pairingFailedDesc: Pairing timed out or failed. Your notes on this device have been kept. You can try pairing again.
overlay.pairingRejectedDesc: The other device declined this pairing request. Your notes on this device have been kept.
overlay.pairingExpiredDesc: That invite is no longer valid. Ask the other device to generate a new one.

empty.typeToFind: Type above to find notes across your library

noteLockPassword.createDesc: This password will be required to open locked notes on all your synced devices.
noteLockPassword.enterDesc: Enter your note lock password to unlock this note.
noteLockPassword.warning: Your password itself is never stored — only a secure verification hash. It cannot be recovered, so if you forget it, locked notes cannot be opened. Write it down and keep it safe.
noteLockPassword.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.

camera.title: Camera Access Needed
camera.message: Pear Notes needs camera access to take photos and videos. Enable it in Settings.

backup.title: Backup / Restore
backup.subtitle: Export or import your data

hero.title: Secure Your Vault
hero.description: Backing up your data ensures you never lose your notes and files. All backups are encrypted with a password you choose and can be safely restored to any of your devices.

backup.lockedAuthReason: Authenticate to back up your locked notes
backup.notificationPermissionDesc: Pear Notes needs notification permission to show backup progress while it runs in the background.
backup.clearAllDataDesc: This will permanently delete ALL notes, folders, settings, and media. This cannot be undone.

progress.readingDesc: Loading and preparing your backup file...
progress.creatingDesc: Encrypting and uploading your vault data...
progress.restoringDesc: Decrypting and restoring your vault data...
progress.restoredDesc: Your notes and data have been restored successfully.
progress.completeDesc: Opening the share sheet to save your backup...

backup.restoreCompleteDesc: Your notes and data have been restored successfully.
backup.confirmExportDesc: Please make sure you have copied your Recovery Key securely. You will need it to restore this backup on other devices.
backup.recoveryKeyDesc: Save this key securely. You will need it to restore this backup on a new device.
backup.enterRecoveryKeyDesc: Please enter the Recovery Key of the device that created this backup.
backup.invalidKeyDesc: The recovery key must be a 64-character hex string.

errors.invalidFile: This file isn't a valid Pear Notes backup.
errors.incorrectPassword: Incorrect password. Please check your backup password and try again.
errors.passwordRequired: This backup is password-protected. Please enter its password.
errors.unsupportedVersion: This backup was made with an incompatible version and cannot be restored.
errors.incorrectRecoveryKey: Incorrect recovery key. Please check the key and try again.

backup.protectedDesc: You choose a password when creating a backup, and it encrypts the file. You'll need that same password to restore — it is never stored, so keep it somewhere safe.

password.createDesc: This password encrypts your backup. You'll need it to restore — it can't be recovered if lost.
password.enterDesc: Enter the password used to create this backup to decrypt your data.

storage.liveMediaProgressLabel: Live media as a share of on-disk storage
